cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Choose the Relationship
cards.instruction: Make someone prioritize this connection over a competing person, promise, or opportunity.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Stay home from the networking dinner. I've finally learned your mother's dumplings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The director's coming. I could get promoted.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then staying would tell me I'm more than the person keeping dinner warm.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Freeze them. We'll have them tomorrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's what you said on our anniversary. Call and say you've already got dinner with me.

mechanism: A refuses to authorize another deferred home dinner and directs cancellation of the competing networking opportunity as proof of relationship priority.
confusable: D75 emotional acknowledgment alone is not D82; the other commitment must be displaced by a choice for this connection.
comparison: A promotion chance versus meaningful home meal differs from a short vow-planning delay before a client.
seedUse: Use D82-b learned family dumplings and previous anniversary postponement, keeping the specific competing opportunity visible.
